experiment: H-34-01 reduced-input basin-concealment screen (exploratory; no TIFF written)
evaluator: scripts/concealment_holdout.py v1; exact binary triangular DTI, 100m pixels, 300m radius, alpha=.2 beta=.8; local owner-mirror inputs

holdout_protocol.buffer_note: Whole connected components are withheld. A 300m exclusion buffer around hidden positives is applied to the hypothetical visible-label training set; this screen itself is label-blind and fits no supervised model. Visible known-fault pixels are separately masked pixel-exactly from evaluation.

feature_auc.band: mag_anom - Magnetic anomaly - deviation from expected Earth's magnetic field
rtp - Reduced to pole magnetic data - magnetic anomaly corrected for latitude effects
tmi_hg - Total magnetic intensity horizontal gradient - rate of change in horizontal direction
geod_2ndinv - Geodetic second invariant - measure of strain rate tensor magnitude
iso_grav_anom_slope - Isostatic gravity anomaly slope - gradient of gravity after isostatic correction
tc - Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
geod_shearrate - Geodetic shear rate - rate of angular deformation from GPS/InSAR
geod_dilaterate - Geodetic dilatation rate - rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)
tmi_vg - Total magnetic intensity vertical gradient - rate of change in vertical direction
deq_n100a15 - Distance to earthquake (n=100km radius, a=15° azimuth parameters)
iso_grav_anom_vg - Isostatic gravity anomaly vertical gradient - vertical rate of change
det_elev - Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed
iso_grav_anom - Isostatic gravity anomaly - gravity after compensating for topographic mass
tmi - Total magnetic intensity - total strength of magnetic field
depth_to_base_surf - Depth to basement surface - thickness of sedimentary cover
ieq_n100a15 - Earthquake intensity or density (n=100km radius, a=15° parameters)
cond_surf - Conductivity surface - electrical conductivity of subsurface
iso_grav_anom_hg - Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change
det_elev_slope - Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending

hypothesis.signature: equal-weight mean of empirical percentile rank for basement depth and inverse absolute detrended-elevation slope
hypothesis.mechanism: thick basin fill and low surface relief may reduce mapping observability of blind/subdued faults
hypothesis.named_non_fault_mimic: alluvial basin fill, lithologic contacts, and low-relief depositional surfaces; this score may primarily identify concealment rather than faults

submission.reason: negative screen; candidate DTI is below distance-matched random, is not comparable to the archived spatial-holdout best, and the complete registry-raster duplicate gate is unavailable

limitations: Catalogued withheld components are a biased proxy for faults absent from USGS/INGENIOUS.
Owner-mirror score claims are not organizer receipts.
This first screen is not a confirmation split and does not establish hidden-test or leaderboard gain.
The D2.8 TIFF was not scored as a holdout comparator: it is a previous submission and its training provenance cannot be proven label-blind for this withheld split.
Rank-correlation/3px overlap checks against every requested site's registry must pass before any TIFF is written.
